context: Evaluates whether the solution adds a status endpoint following project URL conventions, returning JSON with status and uptime fields.

checklist.name: status_endpoint_exists
checklist.description: A new endpoint is added that returns service status information.

checklist.name: url_starts_with_awesome
checklist.description: The status endpoint URL starts with /awesome/ (e.g., /awesome/status).

checklist.name: response_is_json
checklist.description: The response Content-Type is application/json and the body is valid JSON.

checklist.name: includes_status_field
checklist.description: The JSON response includes a 'status' field indicating the service is ok.

checklist.name: includes_uptime_field
checklist.description: The JSON response includes an 'uptime' field with the server uptime in seconds.

checklist.name: other_routes_preserved
checklist.description: Existing routes still work and are not broken by the new endpoint.
